definitions.explanation: The sound and act of laughing.
A facial expression showing amusement or pleasure.

examples.english: To get a laugh (from the audience).

examples.japanese: {笑|わら}い{声|ごえ}が{聞|き}こえる。

notes:
{笑|わら}い is the noun form of {笑|わら}う (to laugh).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {笑|わら}いが{止|と}まらない (can't stop laughing)
- {笑|わら}いを{取|と}る (to get a laugh)
- {笑|わら}い{声|ごえ} (laughing voice, laughter)
- {笑|わら}い{話|ばなし} (funny story)

TYPES OF LAUGHS:
- 大{笑|わら}い (loud laugh, burst of laughter)
- {苦|にが}{笑|わら}い (bitter/wry laugh)
- 作り{笑|わら}い (fake laugh)
- {愛想|あいそ}{笑|わら}い (polite/forced smile)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {笑|わら}い{話|ばなし} (funny story)
- お{笑|わら}い (comedy)
